rules.content:
SELECT account_id, identity_id,
       MAX(utilization_pct) - LAG(MAX(utilization_pct), 30) 
         OVER (PARTITION BY identity_id ORDER BY report_date) as util_change_30d
FROM credit_monitoring
WHERE report_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY account_id, identity_id
HAVING util_change_30d > 60  -- 60%+ utilization jump in 30 days
ORDER BY util_change_30d DESC;
rules.title: SQL — Bust-Out Velocity Detection
rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike")`
`comment("Detects 6+ months low utilization followed by rapid spike to >80%")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  (account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
  trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct<35
  current_utilization_pct>=80
  previous_month_utilization_pct<50
| eval utilization_jump = current_utilization_pct - previous_month_utilization_pct
| eval risk_score = case(
    utilization_jump > 70 AND trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct < 20, "critical",
    utilization_jump > 50, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, account_type, credit_limit, current_balance,
        current_utilization_pct, trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct,
        previous_month_utilization_pct, utilization_jump,
        account_open_date, risk_score
| sort - utilization_jump
rules.title: DL-0151: Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike — Low-and-Slow Buildup Followed by Bust-Out (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Thin-File Identity Clustering")`
`comment("Detects 3+ thin-file applicants sharing address, phone, or device")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
  credit_history_months<12 tradeline_count<3
| stats dc(applicant_id) AS applicant_count,
        values(applicant_id) AS applicants,
        values(phone) AS phones,
        values(device_fingerprint) AS devices,
        values(ssn_hash) AS ssn_hashes,
        min(application_date) AS first_app,
        max(application_date) AS last_app
  BY address
| where applicant_count >= 3
| eval days_span = round((strptime(last_app, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_app, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where days_span <= 180
| eval shared_attribute = "address"
| table address, applicant_count, applicants, phones, devices,
        ssn_hashes, first_app, last_app, days_span
| sort - applicant_count
rules.title: DL-0152: Thin-File Identity Clustering — Shared Address, Phone, or Device Across New Applicants (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Coordinated Bust-Out Timing")`
`comment("Detects 3+ products maxed within 72h for same identity")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  current_utilization_pct>=90
| stats dc(account_id) AS products_maxed,
        sum(transaction_amount) AS total_exposure,
        values(account_id) AS accounts,
        values(transaction_type) AS txn_types,
        values(merchant_category) AS merchants,
        max(credit_limit) AS max_limit
  BY identity_id _time span=72h
| where products_maxed >= 3
| search txn_types="*CASH_ADVANCE*" OR txn_types="*BALANCE_TRANSFER*"
    OR txn_types="*CONVENIENCE_CHECK*"
| eval risk = if(products_maxed >= 5, "critical",
              if(total_exposure > 100000, "critical", "high"))
| table identity_id, products_maxed, total_exposure, accounts,
        txn_types, merchants, risk
| sort - total_exposure
rules.title: DL-0153: Coordinated Bust-Out Timing — Simultaneous Max-Utilization Across Multiple Products (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch")`
`comment("Detects synthetic identity via SSN-DOB-credit file inconsistencies")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
  event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
| eval ssn_dob_gap = ssn_issue_year_estimated - applicant_birth_year
| eval risk_indicator = case(
    applicant_stated_age > 25 AND credit_file_age_months < 18, "late_credit_file",
    ssn_issue_year_estimated > applicant_birth_year, "ssn_postdates_birth",
    applicant_stated_age < 16 AND credit_inquiry_exists="true", "minor_ssn_with_credit",
    1=1, "none")
| where risk_indicator != "none"
| table applicant_id, application_date, applicant_stated_age,
        credit_file_age_months, ssn_issue_year_estimated,
        applicant_birth_year, ssn_dob_gap,
        risk_indicator, address, device_fingerprint
| sort - application_date
rules.title: DL-0154: SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch — Synthetic Identity Indicator (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rapid Authorized User Addition")`
`comment("Detects same individual added as authorized user on 3+ accounts in 30 days")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  event_type="authorized_user_added"
  earliest=-30d@d latest=now
| stats dc(account_id) as distinct_account_count,
        values(account_id) as accounts,
        values(primary_account_holder_id) as primary_holders,
        min(event_date) as first_addition,
        max(event_date) as last_addition
  by authorized_user_id, authorized_user_name
| where distinct_account_count >= 3
| eval addition_span_days = round((strptime(last_addition, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_addition, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    distinct_account_count >= 5, "critical",
    distinct_account_count >= 4, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table authorized_user_id, authorized_user_name, distinct_account_count,
        accounts, primary_holders, first_addition, last_addition,
        addition_span_days, risk_score
| sort - distinct_account_count
rules.title: DL-0157: Rapid Authorized User Addition Across Multiple Accounts (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI-Generated ID Document Detection")`
`comment("Detects document submissions with metadata indicating AI generation")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
| eval anomaly_type = case(
    document_ai_score > 0.7, "high_ai_score",
    match(pdf_creator, "Photoshop|GIMP|Stable Diffusion|Midjourney|DALL-E|unknown_ai_generator")
      AND exif_data_present="false", "suspicious_creator_no_exif",
    pdf_creation_date > pdf_modification_date, "timestamp_manipulation",
    dpi_consistency_check="false", "dpi_inconsistency",
    font_embedding_anomaly="true", "font_anomaly",
    1=1, "none")
| where anomaly_type != "none"
| table applicant_id, submission_timestamp, document_type,
        document_ai_score, pdf_creator, exif_data_present,
        dpi_consistency_check, font_embedding_anomaly,
        anomaly_type, device_fingerprint, ip_address
| sort - submission_timestamp
rules.title: DL-0158: Document Metadata Anomaly — AI-Generated ID Document Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Cross-Application Identity Collision Detection")`
`comment("Detects same biometric or device across different identity applications")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
  earliest=-90d@d
| stats
    dc(applicant_name) as distinct_names,
    dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
    values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
    values(applicant_name) as names,
    values(ssn_hash) as ssn_hashes,
    values(application_date) as application_dates
    by face_embedding_hash
| where distinct_names >= 2 OR distinct_ssns >= 2
| eval identity_collision_type = "biometric_collision"
| append [
    search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
      event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
      earliest=-90d@d
    | stats
        dc(applicant_name) as distinct_names,
        dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
        values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
        values(applicant_name) as names,
        values(ssn_hash) as ssn_hashes,
        values(application_date) as application_dates
        by device_fingerprint
    | where distinct_names >= 2 OR distinct_ssns >= 2
    | eval identity_collision_type = "device_collision"
  ]
| sort - distinct_names
rules.title: DL-0160: Cross-Application Identity Collision — Same Biometric or Device Across Different Identities (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Telecom Subscription Velocity — DL-0184")`
`comment("Detects multiple new service activations from same identity/device within 30 days")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:account_activations
  activation_type="new_account"
| bin _time span=30d
| stats count as activation_count,
        dc(carrier_id) as unique_carriers,
        dc(device_imei) as unique_devices,
        values(carrier_id) as carriers,
        values(device_imei) as devices,
        values(device_model) as device_models,
        values(plan_type) as plan_types,
        sum(device_value) as total_device_value,
        earliest(_time) as first_activation,
        latest(_time) as last_activation
  by identity_hash, _time
| where activation_count >= 3 OR unique_carriers >= 2
| eval risk_score = case(
    activation_count >= 5 AND unique_carriers >= 3, "critical",
    activation_count >= 4 AND total_device_value > 5000, "high",
    activation_count >= 3 OR unique_carriers >= 2, "medium")
| eval days_between = round((last_activation - first_activation) / 86400, 1)
| table identity_hash, activation_count, unique_carriers, unique_devices,
        carriers, devices, device_models, plan_types, total_device_value,
        first_activation, last_activation, days_between, risk_score
| sort - activation_count
rules.title: DL-0184: Telecom Subscription Velocity — Multiple New Service Activations From Same Identity/Device Within 30 Days (SPLUNK)
